summary: Designed async ghost race MVP: client-only /play/race + ?c= invite (t:race,g:100), MatchState.goalM + multiplayer peak fallback, dual-player useRaceClimb, POST /api/climb/result stays solo-only. No WebSocket/APIs. nextStage implementer.
goal: Two players race each other on the same climb map (same seed/tower). Ship async ghost race MVP per locked product-spec.

learnings.insight: Race invite must carry discriminator t:"race" and g:RACE_GOAL_M; decodeRunReplay must reject t==="race" so a challenge token never silently becomes solo replay. Route is /play/race?c= — do not teach /play to read c.
learnings.action: Implement raceInvite.ts + harden runReplay decode; add /play/race page; prove round-trip and cross-decode rejection in tests (not source greps).

learnings.insight: resolveOutcome today never crowns peak winners and nothing sets status=finished in endless solo. Race needs goalM finish-at-y in stepMatch plus multiplayer-only peakY/slot fallback so solo winnerId===null tests stay green.
learnings.action: Add MatchState.goalM; finish when y>=goalM; peak fallback gated on mode==="multiplayer"; prove AC-11/AC-12 with simulateFromInputs.

learnings.insight: MVP adds zero race persist APIs. Race UI must not fetch POST /api/climb/result. Harden that route to 400 RACE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED on raceWin/raceResult/winnerId/opponentPeakY/mode race|multiplayer without calling recordClimb. Free solo LB server-re-sim OQ stays OPEN.
learnings.action: Skip postRun on race surfaces; add climbResult route tests for forged raceWin; do not mark free-LB trust closed.

learnings.insight: paintClimbFrame currently draws only players[0]; ghost race needs both bodies and camera following the live challenger (id you / slot 1).
learnings.action: Amend paintClimbFrame (+ camera target) for N=2; style ghost distinctly (muted/alpha).

learnings.insight: ASCENT + climb chrome already cover race overlays; architect set nextStage=implementer and skipped design-ux-first. Nav honesty still required: Race a friend → /play/race Start recording.
learnings.action: QA walk F-1; escalate to design-ux only if contrast/a11y/chrome fails acceptance.

learnings.insight: Architecture maps AC-1…AC-21 across ~6 new modules (raceConstants, raceInvite, useRaceClimb, Race* clients/overlay, /play/race page), ~5 amended (simulation, types, runReplay, paintClimbFrame, climb/result), 7 ADRs, 0 new HTTP race endpoints, MAX_RACE_TICKS=18000 / MAX_RACE_TOKEN_LENGTH=32768.
learnings.action: Implementer checklist in loop/architecture-two-player-race.md §16; nextStage implementer.

openQuestions: Solo free leaderboard server-re-sim (pre-existing OPEN — race does not close).
Power-up one-slot vs stacking (OPEN — out of scope).
Host recording early-stop at 100 recommended for invite size (non-blocking).

appliedLearnings: product-spec: extend resolveOutcome for 100m + peak fallback
product-spec: no race writes to free solo LB; climb/result solo-only
